title: Ours, yours, theirs: miénk, tiétek, övék

sections.title: Ours, yours (plural), theirs
sections.content: The same pattern works for several owners. *miénk* is 'ours'. *tiétek* is 'yours' when you speak to several people (*tiéd* is for one person). *övék* is 'theirs'. *övé* (his/hers) and *övék* (theirs) differ by one letter, so look at the end.
Say *a tiéd* to one person and *a tiétek* to several. The final *-k* of *övék* is the plural *-k* you know from *barátok*: *övé* is one owner, *övék* is more than one.
